Read core instructions first from the remote `main` branch, then follow required/needed links. Use RAW URLs only; dynamic workflows and workflow assignments MUST resolve from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors, golden files, cached plans, or mirrors for steps/acceptance criteria; delete such artifacts if present. Local modules may be read from `local_ai_instruction_modules`.

Don't assume your shell is bash. Its probably pwsh. Detect what type of shell you have before running any commands. Read before running any terminal commands, of if you need Github CL.I. The web-fetch tool is disabled. Use powershell or curl to fetch files from the web. If there are many files, then create a pwsh script to download them in parallel.

Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required. Prefer automation-first approaches; maximize filesystem effectiveness via MCP/built-in tools. Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort. Maintain ≥90% automation coverage for GitHub operations and document manual exceptions. If GitHub tools (MCP or gh) are not authorized, initiate authentication/login (e.g., start gh auth login); user completes prompts.

Setup script: `setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1`
